snippet.title: LASER FORTRESS - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
LASER FORTRESS is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to hit with a laser red enemies, without touching blue one. You`ve got point by hitting enemies. Blue objects can run foward, between the enemies, you must to control your laster and try not to hit such objects.

The game is over when you hit a blue object.
Developed by Xitilon

#ps4 #playstation4 #xitilon #laserfortress #theforeseenarcade
